instruction: What is my longest ate-homemade-meals habit streak, in number of days, as per my Simple Note habit tracking logs?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, only information retrieval. Password lookup -> simple_note login -> search_notes (query 'habit') lists the habit tracking log notes -> show_note on each log note to read its content -> complete_task with the computed longest consecutive-day streak for ate-homemade-meals. The number of log notes is unknown a priori; two notes are modeled (matching the 6-call reference), with a static answer-from-logs fact tying the answer to the notes that must be read before completion. Listing of notes is captured by the nullary habit-notes-listed knowledge predicate (search_notes returns all matches in one call). The streak count itself is computed by the agent from the note contents, not returned by any API.
